A LITTLE CLARITY

Good questions.
Useful answers.

Does MAK issue Auto Insurance policies?

This website presents MAK’s call-centre campaign services. Policy advice, quotations, and issuance remain with the relevant authorised insurance provider.

How are enquiries handed over?

We agree the qualification questions, required notes, transfer or appointment process, and escalation contacts with the campaign partner before work begins.
